Get clarity on what applies to you, what.da: Få overblik over jeres emballagedata og de spørgsmål, I skal tage med til leverandørerne.

Reduce waste, keep materials in use, and.en: Reduce waste, keep materials in use, and build packaging that meets today’s requirements — and tomorrow’s expectations.
Reduce waste, keep materials in use, and.da: Begræns spild, hold materialer i brug, og udvikl emballage med blik for dagens krav og morgendagens behov.

A practical compass for PPWR readiness.en: A practical compass for PPWR readiness

Pick one product from your shelf. Work t.en: Pick one product from your shelf. Work through these three questions with purchasing, design and your supplier.
Pick one product from your shelf. Work t.da: Tag et produkt ned fra hylden. Brug det til at afklare tre spørgsmål sammen med indkøb, design og jeres leverandør.

Take the pack apart. Record the weight,.en: Take the pack apart. Record the weight, material and function of each part, including labels, coatings and closures. Start with Article 6 when reviewing recyclability.
Take the pack apart. Record the weight,.da: Skil emballagen ad. Notér vægt, materiale og funktion for hver del, også etiketter, belægninger og lukninger. Brug artikel 6 som udgangspunkt, når I undersøger genanvendelighed.

Request dated specifications for the pac.en: Request dated specifications for the packaging type. Identify the manufacturer, then check which documentation and EU declaration requirements apply under Articles 15, 38 and 39 and Annexes VII and VIII. The pack must be traceable to its documentation.
Request dated specifications for the pac.da: Bed om daterede specifikationer for emballagetypen. Afklar, hvem der er fabrikant, og undersøg, hvilke krav til teknisk dokumentation og EU-overensstemmelseserklæring der gælder efter artikel 15, 38 og 39 samt bilag VII og VIII. Emballagen skal kunne knyttes til dokumentationen.

The PPWR has generally applied since 12.en: The PPWR has generally applied since 12 August 2026. Individual requirements have their own timelines. Check the relevant article for the pack you are reviewing.
The PPWR has generally applied since 12.da: PPWR har generelt gældet siden 12. august 2026. Flere krav har deres egne frister. Tjek den relevante artikel for den konkrete emballage.

Want to see the pack before a production.en: Want to see the pack before a production run? Compare size, print and finish on a physical mockup. Include dimensions and the number of variants when asking for a quote.
Want to see the pack before a production.da: Vil I se emballagen, før I bestiller et oplag? Sammenlign format, tryk og finish på en fysisk prøve. Oplys mål og antal varianter, når I beder om en pris.

The film can protect the product from mo.da: Folien kan beskytte produktet mod fugt eller snavs, afhængigt af materialet og hvordan folien lukkes.

Could a lighter insert protect the produ.da: Kan en lettere indsats beskytte produktet lige så godt?

The insert holds the product in place. C.en: The insert holds the product in place. Compare the current insert with a lighter one in a transport test.
The insert holds the product in place. C.da: Indsatsen holder produktet på plads. Sammenlign den nuværende indsats med en lettere i en transporttest.

Could the carton be smaller and still do.en: Could the carton be smaller and still do its job?
Could the carton be smaller and still do.da: Kan kartonæsken være mindre og stadig fungere?

Measure the product, insert and carton..en: Measure the product, insert and carton. Check how much space you need for protection and packing.
Measure the product, insert and carton..da: Mål produkt, indsats og æske. Undersøg, hvor meget plads I har brug for til beskyttelse og pakning.

By 1 January 2030, manufacturers or impo.en: By 1 January 2030, manufacturers or importers must ensure that packaging placed on the market is designed with the minimum weight and volume needed for it to function.
By 1 January 2030, manufacturers or impo.da: Senest 1. januar 2030 skal fabrikanter eller importører sikre, at emballage, der bringes i omsætning, er designet med den mindst mulige vægt og volumen, der stadig sikrer dens funktion.

Questions selected. Use your device’s co.da: Spørgsmålene er markeret. Brug enhedens kopifunktion.

Think about weights, material specificat.en: Think about weights, material specifications and supplier files.
Think about weights, material specificat.da: Tænk på vægt, materialespecifikationer og leverandørdokumenter.

Date and version the specifications you.en: Date and version the specifications you have, then check they describe the pack currently in production.
Date and version the specifications you.da: Datér og versionsmærk jeres specifikationer. Tjek, at de beskriver emballagen i produktion.

Create a gap list. For each missing spec.en: Create a gap list. For each missing specification, give one supplier or colleague a due date.
Create a gap list. For each missing spec.da: Opret en mangelliste. Giv én person og én frist til hver manglende specifikation.

Send the supplier a component list and r.en: Send the supplier a component list and request material, weight, construction and dated evidence for each part.
Send the supplier a component list and r.da: Send leverandøren en komponentliste, og bed om materiale, vægt, konstruktion og dateret dokumentation for hver del.

Bring purchasing, design and quality tog.en: Bring purchasing, design and quality together to locate specifications and agree who maintains them.
Bring purchasing, design and quality tog.da: Saml indkøb, design og kvalitet for at finde specifikationer og aftale, hvem der vedligeholder dem.

An index of file names, dates and owners.en: An index of file names, dates and owners. Give each missing document a follow-up date.
An index of file names, dates and owners.da: En oversigt med filnavn, dato og ansvarlig. Sæt en opfølgningsdato ved de dokumenter, der mangler.

PPWR stands for Packaging and Packaging.en: PPWR stands for Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. Regulation (EU) 2025/40 sets rules for packaging placed on the EU market and covers topics such as packaging design, recyclability and producer responsibility.
PPWR stands for Packaging and Packaging.da: PPWR står for Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. EU-forordning 2025/40 fastsætter regler for emballage på EU-markedet og omfatter blandt andet emballagedesign, genanvendelighed og producentansvar.

When do the new packaging rules apply?.en: When do the new packaging rules apply?

The PPWR has generally applied since 12.en: The PPWR has generally applied since 12 August 2026. Some provisions and specific requirements apply on other dates. Check the dates for the requirement and packaging in question.
The PPWR has generally applied since 12.da: PPWR har som udgangspunkt gældet siden 12. august 2026. Nogle bestemmelser og konkrete krav har andre datoer. Tjek fristen for det krav og den emballage, I arbejder med.

based on your answers and chosen priorit.da: ud fra jeres svar og valgte prioritet.

Work through five steps about one packag.en: Work through five steps about one packaging item, including its material and use for food contact. Your answers generate four tasks. You choose which task comes first.
Work through five steps about one packag.da: Gennemgå fem trin om én emballage, herunder materiale og fødevarekontakt. Jeres svar giver fire arbejdsopgaver. I vælger selv, hvilken opgave der står først.

PPWR is the EU regulation on packaging a.en: PPWR is the EU regulation on packaging and packaging waste. In Denmark, the responsible producer generally first makes the packaging available on the Danish market. Rules vary with packaging type and role, including certain cases of unpacking. Check who must register with Dansk Producentansvar and finance waste management.
PPWR is the EU regulation on packaging a.da: PPWR er EU’s forordning om emballage og emballageaffald. I Danmark er den ansvarlige producent som hovedregel den, der først gør emballagen tilgængelig på det danske marked. Reglerne afhænger af emballagetype og rolle, herunder visse tilfælde af udpakning. Afklar, hvem der skal registreres hos Dansk Producentansvar og finansiere affaldshåndteringen.

Map who makes, imports, distributes or u.en: Map who makes, imports, distributes or unpacks the packaging in each market. Use Article 3 and Chapter IV (Articles 15–23) for roles and duties. Check producer registration under Article 44 and the national rules, including the Danish Packaging Order for Denmark.
Map who makes, imports, distributes or u.da: Kortlæg, hvem der fremstiller, importerer, distribuerer eller udpakker emballagen på hvert marked. Brug artikel 3 og kapitel IV (artikel 15–23) til at afklare roller og pligter. Tjek producentregistrering efter artikel 44 og de nationale regler, herunder emballagebekendtgørelsen i Danmark.

Here are four work tasks for one packagi.da: Her er fire arbejdsopgaver for én emballage. Jeres valgte prioritet står først. Sæt kryds, når I har gennemført en opgave.

This working note covers selected topics.da: Arbejdsnotatet dækker udvalgte emner for én emballage ud fra jeres egne svar. Det er generel information. En vurdering af, om emballagen overholder reglerne, kræver særskilt gennemgang af emballagen, dens anvendelse, markederne og dokumentationen.

Expired results are cleared on the next visit. When you switch languages, the test temporarily passes your progress to the other language in the same tab.
Saving is optional. Saved answers and ch.da: Det er frivilligt at gemme. Gemte svar og afkrydsninger kan gendannes i denne browser i 30 dage fra lagringen. I kan selv slette dem før. Udløbne resultater fjernes ved næste besøg. Skifter I sprog, overføres jeres fremskridt midlertidigt til det andet sprog i samme fane.

What do you do with this packaging?.en: What do you do with this packaging?
What do you do with this packaging?.da: Hvad gør I med denne emballage?

Choose one activity to investigate first.en: Choose one activity to investigate first. You may have several roles. Assess manufacturer duties and extended producer responsibility for packaging waste separately.
Choose one activity to investigate first.da: Vælg én aktivitet at undersøge først. I kan have flere roller. Vurdér fabrikantens pligter og producentansvaret for emballageaffald hver for sig.

We have packaging or packed products mad.en: We have packaging or packed products made under our own brand
We have packaging or packed products mad.da: Vi får emballage eller emballerede varer fremstillet under eget mærke

We buy packaging or packed products with.en: We buy packaging or packed products within the EU
We buy packaging or packed products with.da: Vi køber emballage eller emballerede varer inden for EU

We distribute packaging or packed produc.en: We distribute packaging or packed products
We distribute packaging or packed produc.da: Vi distribuerer emballage eller emballerede varer

Where is this packaging or packed produc.en: Where is this packaging or packed product first made available in the course of business?
Where is this packaging or packed produc.da: Hvor gøres denne emballage eller emballerede vare første gang tilgængelig som led i erhverv?

Consider each country. Include free samp.en: Consider each country. Include free samples and cross-border deliveries. If you unpack goods without being the end user, check whether that gives you producer responsibility.
Consider each country. Include free samp.da: Se på hvert land for sig. Medregn gratis vareprøver og leverancer på tværs af grænser. Hvis I pakker varer ud uden selv at være slutbruger, skal I undersøge, om det giver jer producentansvar.

Inside and outside the EU, including Den.en: Inside and outside the EU, including Denmark
Inside and outside the EU, including Den.da: I og uden for EU, herunder Danmark

Inside and outside the EU, excluding Den.en: Inside and outside the EU, excluding Denmark
Inside and outside the EU, excluding Den.da: I og uden for EU, uden Danmark

What is the packaging made of?.en: What is the packaging made of?

Choose the material. For food contact, c.en: Choose the material. For food contact, consider intended use, actual contact in normal use, and foreseeable contact or transfer of constituents to food.
Choose the material. For food contact, c.da: Vælg materiale. Ved fødevarekontakt skal I medregne tilsigtet og faktisk kontakt ved normal brug samt kontakt eller afgivelse af stoffer til fødevarer, som med rimelighed kan forventes.

Is the packaging intended for food conta.en: Is the packaging intended for food contact, or can contact or transfer of substances to food reasonably be expected?
Is the packaging intended for food conta.da: Er emballagen beregnet til fødevarekontakt, eller kan kontakt eller afgivelse af stoffer til fødevarer med rimelighed forventes?

A country list with the first supply, th.en: A country list with the first supply, the responsible business and any registration deadline.
A country list with the first supply, th.da: En landeliste med første tilgængeliggørelse, ansvarlig virksomhed og eventuel registreringsfrist.

Identify the legal manufacturer under Ar.en: Identify the legal manufacturer under Article 3. Record who holds the technical file and who is authorised to sign the EU declaration on the manufacturer’s behalf. An agreement on who does the work does not transfer the manufacturer’s legal responsibility.
Identify the legal manufacturer under Ar.da: Afklar, hvem der er fabrikant efter artikel 3. Notér, hvem der har den tekniske dokumentation, og hvem der må underskrive EU-overensstemmelseserklæringen på fabrikantens vegne. En aftale om arbejdsfordeling overfører ikke fabrikantens retlige ansvar.

If you have packaging or packed goods ma.en: If you have packaging or packed goods made under your own name or trademark, you are generally the manufacturer. For qualifying micro-enterprises, Article 3(1)(13)(b) refers to a supplier in the same Member State. Under Article 15(12), a qualifying micro-enterprise’s packaging supplier in the EU bears the manufacturer’s duties under that article, even across a Member State border. Identify the supplier and assess extended producer responsibility separately.
If you have packaging or packed goods ma.da: Får I emballage eller emballerede varer fremstillet under eget navn eller varemærke, er I som hovedregel fabrikant. For mikrovirksomheder, der opfylder betingelserne, henviser artikel 3, stk. 1, nr. 13, litra b, til en leverandør i samme medlemsstat. Efter artikel 15, stk. 12, påhviler pligterne i den artikel emballageleverandøren i EU, når betingelserne er opfyldt. Det gælder også ved levering fra et andet EU-land. Afklar, hvem leverandøren er, og vurdér producentansvaret for affald særskilt.

Record where the packaging first entered.en: Record where the packaging first entered the EU market. Buying in another EU country does not by itself make you an importer under PPWR. If you supply the packaging onward, check distributor duties and who has producer responsibility in each relevant country.
Record where the packaging first entered.da: Notér, hvor emballagen først blev bragt i omsætning i EU. Køb i et andet EU-land gør jer ikke i sig selv til importør efter PPWR. Leverer I emballagen videre, så afklar distributørpligterne og producentansvaret i hvert relevant land.

Identify who is established in the EU an.en: Identify who is established in the EU and first places the packaging from the non-EU country on the EU market. If you place packaging under your own name or modify it in a way that can affect compliance, check whether manufacturer duties also apply.
Identify who is established in the EU an.da: Afklar, hvem der er etableret i EU og først bringer emballagen fra tredjelandet i omsætning i EU. Hvis I bringer emballagen i omsætning under eget navn eller ændrer den på en måde, der kan påvirke overensstemmelsen, skal I undersøge, om I også har fabrikantpligter.

Record who supplies each packaging item.en: Record who supplies each packaging item and which business is the registered producer for each market. Check your distributor duties before making the packaging available.
Record who supplies each packaging item.da: Registrér, hvem der leverer hver emballage, og hvem der er registreret som producent på hvert marked. Tjek distributørpligterne, før I gør emballagen tilgængelig.

List packaging you add, including labels.en: List packaging you add, including labels, tape and fill. Clarify whether you are the manufacturer, who has producer responsibility, and which rules on empty space apply to the packaging you fill.
List packaging you add, including labels.da: Notér den emballage, I tilføjer, herunder etiketter, tape og fyld. Afklar, om I er fabrikant, hvem der har producentansvaret, og hvilke regler om tomrum der gælder for den emballage, I fylder.

Map who makes, buys, imports, fills, sup.en: Map who makes, buys, imports, fills, supplies or unpacks the packaging. If a micro-enterprise commissions own-brand packaging, check the supplier’s country against Articles 3 and 15(12).
Map who makes, buys, imports, fills, sup.da: Kortlæg, hvem der fremstiller, køber, importerer, fylder, leverer eller udpakker emballagen. Bestiller en mikrovirksomhed emballage under eget mærke, skal leverandørens land vurderes efter artikel 3 og artikel 15, stk. 12.

Record when and how the packaging is fir.en: Record when and how the packaging is first supplied in Denmark, including samples.
Record when and how the packaging is fir.da: Notér, hvornår og hvordan emballagen første gang leveres i Danmark, inklusive vareprøver.

List Denmark and each other EU country s.en: List Denmark and each other EU country separately, with the first supply and the responsible producer.
List Denmark and each other EU country s.da: Notér Danmark og hvert andet EU-land for sig med første tilgængeliggørelse og ansvarlig producent.

List each EU country separately and chec.en: List each EU country separately and check its producer register. Direct deliveries to end users in another Member State can trigger producer responsibility there.
List each EU country separately and chec.da: Notér hvert EU-land for sig, og tjek dets producentregister. Direkte leverancer til slutbrugere i en anden medlemsstat kan udløse producentansvar dér.

Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Lis.en: Separate EU and non-EU destinations. List Denmark and each other EU country separately. Check the rules in each non-EU destination.
Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Lis.da: Adskil markeder i og uden for EU. Notér Danmark og hvert andet EU-land for sig. Tjek reglerne på hvert marked uden for EU.

Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Che.en: Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Check the producer register in each relevant EU country and the rules in each non-EU destination.
Separate EU and non-EU destinations. Che.da: Adskil markeder i og uden for EU. Tjek producentregistret i hvert relevant EU-land og reglerne på hvert marked uden for EU.

Check the destination’s rules. If this p.en: Check the destination’s rules. If this packaging is only supplied outside the EU, it is outside the EU market requirements described here. Verify whether the packaging is first supplied or relevant unpacking occurs in the EU before export. If so, reassess your EU and national obligations.
Check the destination’s rules. If this p.da: Tjek reglerne på destinationsmarkedet. Hvis emballagen kun tilgængeliggøres uden for EU, falder den uden for de EU-markedskrav, der beskrives her. Undersøg, om emballagen først leveres, eller om relevant udpakning sker i EU før eksport. Hvis ja, skal I vurdere EU-krav og nationale pligter igen.

Map the first commercial supply in each.en: Map the first commercial supply in each country from orders, dispatches, free samples and direct sales. Check whether unpacking without being the end user affects your producer role.
Map the first commercial supply in each.da: Kortlæg den første erhvervsmæssige tilgængeliggørelse i hvert land ud fra ordrer, forsendelser, gratis vareprøver og direkte salg. Undersøg, om udpakning uden at være slutbruger påvirker jeres producentrolle.

If you have the manufacturer’s duties un.en: If you have the manufacturer’s duties under Article 15, assess conformity or have it assessed, and draw up the technical file before placing packaging on the EU market. Once conformity is demonstrated, issue the EU declaration. Keep both documents for five years for single-use packaging or ten years for reusable packaging, from first placement on the market. Paragraph 11 exempts certain custom-made transport packaging for configurable medical devices and medical systems from paragraphs 2 and 3.
If you have the manufacturer’s duties un.da: Har I fabrikantpligterne efter artikel 15, skal I vurdere eller få vurderet overensstemmelsen og udarbejde teknisk dokumentation, før emballagen bringes i omsætning i EU. Udsted EU-overensstemmelseserklæringen, når overensstemmelsen er påvist. Opbevar begge dokumenter i fem år for engangsemballage og ti år for genbrugsemballage fra første omsætning. Stk. 11 undtager visse specialfremstillede transportemballager til konfigurerbart medicinsk udstyr og medicinske systemer fra stk. 2 og 3.

If you are the importer, check the manuf.en: If you are the importer, check the manufacturer’s conformity assessment, technical documentation, required accompanying documents, applicable markings and identification before placing the packaging on the EU market. Add your importer details as required. Keep a copy of the EU declaration and make sure the technical file can be supplied to the authorities.
If you are the importer, check the manuf.da: Er I importør, skal I kontrollere fabrikantens overensstemmelsesvurdering, tekniske dokumentation, krævede ledsagedokumenter, gældende mærkning og identifikation, før I bringer emballagen i omsætning i EU. Tilføj de krævede importøroplysninger. Opbevar en kopi af EU-overensstemmelseserklæringen, og sørg for, at myndighederne kan få den tekniske dokumentation.

If you distribute the packaging, check p.en: If you distribute the packaging, check producer registration, any applicable Article 12 labelling, and the manufacturer’s and importer’s required identification and contact details before making it available. Hold back packaging if you have reason to believe it fails the applicable requirements.
If you distribute the packaging, check p.da: Distribuerer I emballagen, skal I før tilgængeliggørelsen kontrollere producentregistrering, eventuel gældende mærkning efter artikel 12 og fabrikantens og importørens krævede identifikation og kontaktoplysninger. Hold emballagen tilbage, hvis I har grund til at tro, at den ikke opfylder de gældende krav.

A producer covered by section 15 must re.en: A producer covered by section 15 must register with Dansk Producentansvar at least 14 days before first making the packaging available on the Danish market.
A producer covered by section 15 must re.da: En producent omfattet af emballagebekendtgørelsens § 15 skal registreres hos Dansk Producentansvar senest 14 dage før første tilgængeliggørelse på det danske marked.

List fibres, coatings, inks and adhesive.en: List fibres, coatings, inks and adhesives.
List fibres, coatings, inks and adhesive.da: Registrér fibre, belægninger, trykfarver og lim.

Record the polymers and identify which p.en: Record the polymers and identify which parts contain plastic.
Record the polymers and identify which p.da: Notér polymertyperne, og registrér, hvilke dele der indeholder plast.

Record the glass type and separate closu.en: Record the glass type and separate closures, labels and coatings in your list.
Record the glass type and separate closu.da: Notér glastypen, og registrér lukninger, etiketter og belægninger særskilt.

Record the metal type and separate linin.en: Record the metal type and separate linings, closures and labels in your list.
Record the metal type and separate linin.da: Notér metaltypen, og registrér indvendige belægninger, lukninger og etiketter særskilt.

Record each layer or component, includin.en: Record each layer or component, including any plastic, and note what can be separated.
Record each layer or component, includin.da: Registrér hvert lag eller hver del, herunder eventuel plast, og notér, hvad der kan skilles ad.

Identify the material and each component.en: Identify the material and each component with the supplier.
Identify the material and each component.da: Afklar materialet og de enkelte dele med leverandøren.

The general recyclability requirement ap.en: The general recyclability requirement applies to packaging placed on the EU market from 12 August 2026, subject to Article 6 exemptions. During the transition, use the Commission guidance on the earlier packaging rules and standards. Harmonised design criteria apply from 1 January 2030 or 24 months after the relevant delegated acts enter into force, whichever is later. Recycling at scale applies from 1 January 2035 or five years after the relevant implementing acts enter into force, whichever is later.
The general recyclability requirement ap.da: Emballage, der bringes i omsætning i EU fra 12. august 2026, skal som hovedregel kunne genanvendes. Tjek undtagelserne i artikel 6 og Kommissionens vejledning om de tidligere emballageregler og standarder i overgangsperioden. De harmoniserede designkriterier gælder fra 1. januar 2030 eller 24 måneder efter de relevante delegerede retsakters ikrafttræden, hvis det er senere. Kravet om genanvendelse i stor skala gælder fra 1. januar 2035 eller fem år efter de relevante gennemførelsesretsakters ikrafttræden, hvis det er senere.

For plastic parts covered by Article 7,.en: For plastic parts covered by Article 7, check the minimum recycled content for the packaging category. The first targets apply from 1 January 2030 or three years after the implementing act under Article 7(8) enters into force, whichever is later. Check exemptions, including for a plastic part below 5% of the total packaging-unit weight.
For plastic parts covered by Article 7,.da: For plastdele omfattet af artikel 7 skal I undersøge minimumskravet til genanvendt indhold for emballagetypen. De første krav gælder fra 1. januar 2030 eller tre år efter ikrafttrædelsen af gennemførelsesretsakten efter artikel 7, stk. 8, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Tjek undtagelserne, blandt andet for plastdele under 5 % af emballageenhedens samlede vægt.

Since 12 August 2026, food-contact packa.en: Since 12 August 2026, food-contact packaging placed on the EU market must meet the PFAS limits in Article 5(5). Ask the supplier for evidence for your packaging. Earlier manufacture gives no stock grace period. Packaging already placed on the EU market before that date may remain available.
Since 12 August 2026, food-contact packa.da: Siden 12. august 2026 skal fødevarekontaktemballage, der bringes i omsætning i EU, overholde PFAS-grænserne i artikel 5, stk. 5. Bed leverandøren om dokumentation for jeres emballage. Tidligere fremstilling giver ingen frist til at afvikle lageret. Emballage, der allerede var bragt i omsætning i EU før datoen, må fortsat være tilgængelig.

Clarify normal and foreseeable use with.en: Clarify normal and foreseeable use with the supplier. If the packaging is for food contact, check the PFAS limits and the food-contact material rules, and request evidence for this pack.
Clarify normal and foreseeable use with.da: Afklar normal og forudsigelig brug med leverandøren. Ved fødevarekontakt skal I tjekke PFAS-grænserne og reglerne for fødevarekontaktmaterialer og indhente dokumentation for emballagen.

If you fill sales packaging, reduce empt.en: If you fill sales packaging, reduce empty space to what is needed for function and protection by 12 February 2028. If you fill grouped, transport or e-commerce packaging, the maximum is 50% from 1 January 2030 or three years after the relevant implementing acts enter into force, whichever is later. Fill material counts as empty space. Sales packs used as e-commerce packs and reusable packs in a reuse system are exempt from the 50% rule. Check Article 24(4) and (5) for the precise conditions.
If you fill sales packaging, reduce empt.da: Fylder I salgsemballage, skal tomrummet senest 12. februar 2028 begrænses til det nødvendige for funktion og beskyttelse. Fylder I multipak-, transport- eller e-handelsemballage, er grænsen 50 % fra 1. januar 2030 eller tre år efter de relevante gennemførelsesretsakters ikrafttræden, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Fyldmateriale tæller som tomrum. Salgsemballage brugt som e-handelsemballage og genbrugsemballage i et genbrugssystem er undtaget fra 50 %-reglen. Tjek artikel 24, stk. 4 og 5, for de præcise betingelser.

Confirm that no relevant supply or unpac.en: Confirm that no relevant supply or unpacking takes place in the EU. Ask what packaging and documentation rules apply at the destination.
Confirm that no relevant supply or unpac.da: Afklar, om der er relevant tilgængeliggørelse eller udpakning i EU. Undersøg emballage- og dokumentationskravene på destinationsmarkedet.

The browser could not delete the saved c.da: Browseren kunne ikke slette den gemte tjekliste.

Choose whether the packaging is for food.en: Choose whether the packaging is for food contact.
Choose whether the packaging is for food.da: Angiv, om emballagen er beregnet til fødevarekontakt.

You have marked all four tasks as done..en: You have marked all four tasks as done. Follow up on open questions with the person responsible.
You have marked all four tasks as done..da: I har markeret alle fire opgaver som løst. Følg op på åbne spørgsmål med den ansvarlige.

We place packaging or packed products fr.en: We place packaging or packed products from a non-EU country on the EU market
We place packaging or packed products fr.da: Vi bringer emballage eller emballerede varer fra et tredjeland i omsætning i EU

The harmonised material-composition labe.en: The harmonised material-composition label generally applies from 12 August 2028 or 24 months after the relevant implementing acts enter into force, whichever is later. Check Article 12 for exceptions and other labelling deadlines.
The harmonised material-composition labe.da: Det harmoniserede mærke om materialesammensætning gælder som hovedregel fra 12. august 2028 eller 24 måneder efter de relevante gennemførelsesretsakters ikrafttræden, alt efter hvad der ligger senest. Tjek artikel 12 for undtagelser og andre mærkningsfrister.

The checklist suggests what to investiga.en: The checklist suggests what to investigate. It does not verify your packaging or its documentation.
The checklist suggests what to investiga.da: Tjeklisten viser, hvad I kan undersøge. Den kontrollerer ikke jeres emballage eller dokumentation.

The combined amount of lead, cadmium, me.en: The combined amount of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium in packaging or its components is generally limited to 100 mg/kg. Under Article 5(6), compliance with the applicable limits must be shown in the technical documentation. Check whether a specific derogation applies.
The combined amount of lead, cadmium, me.da: Det samlede indhold af bly, cadmium, kviksølv og hexavalent chrom i emballage eller emballagekomponenter må som hovedregel højst være 100 mg/kg. Efter artikel 5, stk. 6, skal overholdelsen af de relevante grænser fremgå af den tekniske dokumentation. Tjek, om en særlig undtagelse gælder.

Potential EU requirement pending confirm.en: Potential EU requirement pending confirmation of the market:
Potential EU requirement pending confirm.da: Muligt EU-krav, indtil markedet er afklaret:

These checkmarks were saved under earlie.en: These checkmarks were saved under earlier guidance. Review the updated tasks before relying on the marks.
These checkmarks were saved under earlie.da: Afkrydsningerne er gemt med en tidligere vejledning. Gennemgå de opdaterede opgaver, før I bruger afkrydsningerne.
